methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified via WebFetch against each vendor's official pricing page (snyk.io/plans, socket.dev/pricing, mend.io/pricing, debricked.com/pricing, fossa.com/pricing, endorlabs.com/pricing) on 2026-06-18, plus vendor trust/security pages and the cited compliance blog posts. Where a tier is sales-quote-only with no published number, monthlyUsd is null (no estimates). Annual-only prices are reported as their monthly-equivalent with a note. Debricked's page is live and now branded OpenText Fortify SCA / 'Debricked by OpenText'; plan structure and prices unchanged from the draft. All compliance flags set true only where the vendor explicitly states the certification; GDPR/HIPAA left null where not explicitly claimed. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Snyk
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified at snyk.io/plans on 2026-06-18; compliance from snyk.io/security. Snyk states SOC 2 Type II (assessed by Schellman) and ISO 27001/27017; HIPAA not listed. Prices: Free $0, Team $25/dev/mo (min 5, max 10), Ignite $1,260/dev/yr (=$105/mo), Enterprise quote-only.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited contributing developers; 200 Open Source tests/month, 100 Code tests/month, 300 IaC tests/month, 100 Container tests/month. No credit card required.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Starting at $25 per contributing developer/month. Minimum 5, maximum 10 contributing developers per org. 1,000 Open Source tests/month, up to 1,000 Code tests/month, unlimited IaC and Container tests. 1 month free with annual billing (~8% effective discount).

plans.name: Ignite
plans.notes: $1,260/year per contributing developer (billed annually only); $105/mo monthly-equivalent. Up to 50 contributing developers. Unlimited tests across all products. 10 DAST targets included.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. Unlimited contributing developers, unlimited tests, FedRAMP compliance, enhanced support.

limits: Free: 200 Open Source tests/month, 100 Code tests/month, 300 IaC tests/month, 100 Container tests/month
Team: min 5 / max 10 contributing developers per org, 1,000 Open Source tests/month
Ignite: up to 50 contributing developers, annual billing required
keyFeatures: Developer-first SCA with IDE and CLI integrations
AI-assisted remediation with fix pull requests
Reachability analysis to prioritize exploitable vulnerabilities
Unified platform covering Open Source, Code (SAST), IaC, and Container scanning
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from snyk.io/plans; compliance from snyk.io/security. SOC 2 Type II confirmed (Schellman); GDPR commitment stated; HIPAA not mentioned. Note: Snyk's security page says it offers no formal certificate but SOC 2 report is available on request.

vendors.name: Socket
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified at socket.dev/pricing on 2026-06-18. Free $0, Team $25/dev/mo, Business $50/dev/mo, Enterprise quote-only; 20% annual discount on Team and Business. SOC 2 confirmed via socket.dev blog (page notes Type II since achieved). GDPR/HIPAA not explicitly stated.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1,000 scans/month, up to 5 members, 1 repository label. Detects 70+ risk types including malware, vulnerabilities, and license issues. Permanently free for open-source projects.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Per developer/month. Up to 10 members, 5,000 scans/month, 3 repository labels. Includes reachability analysis. 20% discount with annual billing.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per developer/month. Unlimited members and scans, 3 repository labels. SBOM support, compliance integrations, GitHub Actions scanning. 20% discount with annual billing.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. Unlimited members, scans, and repository labels. Full function-level reachability. Volume-based discounts; ACH/wire available for annual contracts.

limits: Free: 1,000 scans/month, up to 5 members, 1 repository label
keyFeatures: Proactive malware and supply-chain attack detection (70+ risk types)
Reachability analysis to cut CVE false positives
Deep package inspection without uploading source code
SIEM integrations (Splunk, Datadog, Sentinel) for security operations
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from socket.dev/pricing; SOC 2 confirmed via blog (Type I announced, page notes Type II since achieved). GDPR and HIPAA not explicitly stated, set null.

vendors.name: Mend (formerly WhiteSource)
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified at mend.io/pricing on 2026-06-18. All three products are list-price maximums ('up to $X/dev/year') with actual cost quote-driven, so monthlyUsd is null. Compliance from mend.io/trust: SOC 2 Type II (Schellman), ISO 27001/27017/27701, GDPR; HIPAA not mentioned.

plans.name: Mend AppSec
plans.notes: Up to $1,000/developer/year (billed annually), quote-driven so no fixed monthly price. Includes SAST, reachability-driven SCA, container scanning, AI-generated code security, AI-powered remediation, automated dependency updates. No per-scan or per-project fees.

plans.name: Mend AI
plans.notes: Up to $300/developer/year (billed annually), quote-driven. AI component discovery (AI-BoM), system prompt hardening, automated red teaming, runtime guardrails, continuous AI governance.

plans.name: Mend Renovate Enterprise
plans.notes: Up to $250/developer/year (billed annually), quote-driven. Automated dependency management, full-scale automation, Merge Confidence ratings, dedicated support.

limits: Contributing developer = any employee/contractor accessing the UI or writing/modifying scanned code
Published prices are maximums; actual quotes may be lower
keyFeatures: Reachability-driven SCA to surface only exploitable vulnerabilities
Automated dependency updates via Mend Renovate (open-source core)
AI security for AI-generated code and AI component governance
Unified SAST + SCA + container scanning under one per-developer price
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from mend.io/pricing (list-price maximums, quote-driven); compliance from mend.io/trust (SOC 2 Type II via Schellman, ISO 27001/27017/27701, GDPR). HIPAA not stated.

vendors.name: Debricked (OpenText Core SCA / Fortify SCA)
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified at debricked.com/pricing on 2026-06-18. Page is live with hybrid OpenText Fortify SCA / 'Debricked by OpenText' branding. Free $0, Premium $25/dev/mo ($275/yr), Enterprise from $30/dev/mo ($360/yr), OSS Select Free $0, OSS Select Enterprise $96/dev/yr. Compliance not published on pricing page; left null.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1,000 initial scan credits in the first month, then 100 scans/month thereafter. Includes Vulnerability Management, License Management, Project Health. No credit card required.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per contributing developer/month ($275/year per developer with annual billing). Unlimited scans. Adds Vulnerability Report, License Report, API access (5,000 requests/hour/developer), chat and email support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Starting at $30/contributing developer/month ($360/year). Unlimited scans, unlimited API access, SBOM export, Enterprise SSO, increased computation, enterprise-level support.

plans.name: Open Source Select Free
plans.notes: Free access to the open source component intelligence database (40M+ projects) for filtering and comparison. No scanning included.

plans.name: Open Source Select Enterprise
plans.notes: $96/contributing developer/year (annual billing only; ~$8/mo equivalent). Adds Start Left Policies and unlimited API access to the open source database.

limits: Free: 1,000 scan credits first month, 100 scans/month thereafter
Open Source Select Enterprise: annual billing only
keyFeatures: Open source component intelligence database covering 40M+ projects
SBOM export on Enterprise tier
License compliance and vulnerability management in one platform
CI/CD integration via GitHub Actions and Jenkins plugins
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from debricked.com/pricing (now OpenText Fortify SCA / 'Debricked by OpenText'). Compliance not published on the pricing page; OpenText enterprise compliance requires contacting sales, so flags left null.

vendors.name: FOSSA
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified at fossa.com/pricing on 2026-06-18. Free $0, Business $20 PER PROJECT/month (billed annually) — not per developer — Enterprise quote-only. SOC 2 confirmed via fossa.com/trust; HIPAA not stated.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever free. 5 projects, 10 contributing developers, 1 release group, 5 dependency levels, 1 quality check (outdated packages), 5 imported SBOMs. Includes container scanning, basic email support, API access, SBOM export.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $20 PER PROJECT/month billed annually (priced per project, NOT per developer). Up to 10 projects, 10 contributing developers, 1 release group, unlimited dependency levels, full quality check suite, unlimited imported SBOMs. Automated license and vulnerability scanning, multi-project reporting, priority support. ~10% savings with annual billing.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. Unlimited projects, custom developer count, unlimited release groups and dependency levels. Adds enterprise APIs, SSO, RBAC, custom deployment options, advanced compliance reporting. Optional add-ons: Snippet Scanning, Binary Scanning.

limits: Free: 5 projects, 10 developers, 5 imported SBOMs, 1 quality check
Business: 10 projects, 10 developers, annual billing required
Business: priced per project ($20/project/mo), FOSSA CLI required for scanning
keyFeatures: License compliance focus with deep dependency-level analysis
SBOM import and export across all tiers including free
Snippet scanning for AI-generated and unlicensed code (Enterprise add-on)
Binary scanning for compiled artifacts and containers (Enterprise add-on)
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from fossa.com/pricing; SOC 2 confirmed from fossa.com/trust. Business plan is priced PER PROJECT ($20/project/mo), not per developer — modeled as billingModel 'flat' (per-project unit) since the schema has no per_project value. GDPR/HIPAA not stated, null.

vendors.name: Endor Labs
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified at endorlabs.com/pricing on 2026-06-18. Developer (Free) $0; Core and Pro are quote-only (no published price), so monthlyUsd null. SOC 2 Type II confirmed via Endor Labs blog; page also lists FedRAMP, ISO 42001, PCI DSS, CRA.

plans.name: Developer (Free)
plans.notes: Permanently free, no account required. Local scanning only, read-only vulnerability data access. No UI, no policies, no scan history. For individual developer evaluation.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Pricing not published; contact sales. Team deployments with reachability analysis, vulnerability prioritization, and policies. Seat-based pricing with volume discounts as contributor count grows.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Pricing not published; contact sales. Built for scale with advanced features for detecting, triaging, and fixing vulnerabilities. Includes SBOM Hub, Package Firewall, Agent Governance, and Patches.

limits: Free: local scanning only, no UI or scan history, no account required
Core/Pro: seat-based with fair-usage annual quotas (not hard-enforced)
Scan credits available for purchase for scan-intensive workflows
keyFeatures: Function-level reachability analysis for accurate vulnerability prioritization
SBOM Hub for generating and managing SBOMs and VEX documents
Package Firewall to block malicious or unapproved dependencies at install time
AI agent governance to discover and control AI components in the supply chain
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from endorlabs.com/pricing; Core/Pro are quote-only. SOC 2 Type II confirmed from company blog. FedRAMP, ISO 42001, PCI DSS, CRA also mentioned on the pricing page. GDPR/HIPAA not explicitly claimed, null.
